text:
NOTE
**Still not ready — merge commit still in the history**

New: The author pushed twice and asked for review, but the commit list is unchanged and still includes "Merge branch 'main' into fix-view-all-users-focus". Missing: rebase onto main to remove the merge commit, leaving one coherent commit.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet; laurynmm gave the original feedback and can check again once the history is clean.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The history still has a "Merge branch 'main'" commit, so please rebase onto main instead of merging and force-push so it's a single clean commit (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html)). Then request review again.
```
